# Grandchildren removed inside a covering ancestor flight stay mounted

## Context

Found through the Fleet Manager's first-run path (institution #74 → #76): after the roster list renders EMPTY once, the next row that arrives renders as an empty `li` — the pooled `AgentCard` instance is re-seated by reference, and the reference resolves to a node that left the DOM. Measured live on 2026-09-02 through the Neural Link (session-scoped, the Browser-pane cockpit): 11 pooled cards `mounted: true` → `fleetRoster.clear()` → DOM has 0 `li`, title `Fleet · 0 agents`, and all 11 cards STILL `mounted: true` → `add([2 rows])` → two `li` with zero children, title `Fleet · 2 agents`, zero `.fm-agent-card`; cards 0/1 re-seated, cards 2–10 flipped to `mounted: false` only now (the refill's own sync ran the unmount pass; the empty pass never did). So a settled-empty roster followed by ANY refill blanks the whole fleet grid — not a first-run-only defect.

Pinned in isolation with an Engine unit spec (three arms, run against `dev@46c441eaba`): a pool container updating ALONE unmounts its removed pooled children (green); the same removal merged into an ancestor flight with `updateDepth: -1` leaves them `mounted: true` with stale vnodes (red); the consequence arm re-seats one of them by reference and the update produces ZERO deltas (red) — the placeholder points at a node that no longer exists.

## The Problem

A component that is removed from the tree inside a parent's delta must be told, and so must its descendants. `syncVnodeTree` tells the direct children of the component that received the vnode — one level. When a child's update is merged into an ancestor's flight and the ancestor's depth covers it, the child never receives a vnode of its own, its `syncVnodeTree` never runs, and its removed children keep `mounted: true` and their old vnodes. The tree builder then treats every later reference to them as a placeholder ("move my existing node here") for a node the DOM no longer has.

Any pooled-instance renderer (`list.Component`, the calendar component lists, the fleet roster) that clears and refills while an ancestor is updating in the same tick hits this. The observable is silent: no error, an empty node.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs` `syncVnodeTree()` (~L905): pass 1 iterates `ComponentManager.getChildren(me)` — the components whose nodes are present in the NEW vnode (`VNodeUtil.getChildIds` skips `componentId` placeholders) — and sets `component._vnode` SILENTLY (~L946), so `afterSetVnode` never fires for them and their own `syncVnodeTree` never runs. Pass 2 (~L955–973, the #8868 fix `286640b2d4`) unmounts only `ComponentManager.getDirectChildren(me.id)` that are neither in the new tree nor found in `vnodeMap` — one level.
- `syncVnodeTree` has exactly one caller: `afterSetVnode` (~L125). A component gets a vnode only when `response.vnodes[id]` carries one (~L349–363).
- `mergeIntoParentUpdate` (~L538 region) merges a child into ANY ancestor whose `needsVdomUpdate` is set — `canMergeUpdate` returns `true` unconditionally — and the collision filter in `executeVdomUpdate` (~L289–309) deletes the child's disjoint payload when an ancestor's flight covers it (`parentDepth === -1 || parentDepth > distance`). Covered child ⇒ no own vnode ⇒ no own sync ⇒ its removed children are never unmounted.
- `src/util/vdom/TreeBuilder.mjs` `#buildTree` (~L59–84): a referenced component WITH a vnode is sent as a placeholder (`{componentId, neoIgnore: true}` when pruned, or a reference the worker moves); only a component WITHOUT a vnode is inlined from its `vdom`. A stale vnode therefore turns a re-seat into a move of a missing node.
- The pruned-branch case is safe for the fix: the worker keeps a pruned child's previous subtree in the returned vnode (ids present), so `vnodeMap` contains kept children and lacks only removed ones — the distinction pass 2 already relies on.

## The Fix

`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs`, `syncVnodeTree()`:

1. Extract pass 2 into a module-level helper `unmountRemovedChildren(parent, vnodeMap, presentSet)`: for each `ComponentManager.getDirectChildren(parent.id)` that is not in the present set, not found in `vnodeMap` by its `vdom.id`, and not `floating` → unmount.
2. Run that helper for `me` (today's pass 2) AND for every component pass 1 synced — the components whose subtree the new vnode carries in full. One `childMap` lookup per synced component; no vnode crawl, no change to pass 1's membership (the 2026-03 `getChildComponents` swap that broke the grid teleportation specs stays rejected).
3. Unmounting recurses over the logical subtree of the removed component (`getDirectChildren` recursively, skipping `floating`): `_vnode = null`, `mounted = false` — a removed subtree's descendants cannot stay mounted either, or the re-inlined parent references children with stale vnodes one level down (the institution's third fix shape lost the card's avatar `Image` exactly this way).
4. The reproducer lands beside `test/playwright/unit/vdom/HiddenChildren.spec.mjs` (#8868's, the one-level precedent) as `PooledChildUnmount.spec.mjs` — control, merged, consequence.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/vdom/PooledChildUnmount.spec.mjs` exists with the three arms (control, merged into a covering ancestor flight, re-seat consequence) and is green; the merged and consequence arms are shown red at the pre-fix head in the PR.
- [ ] The removal recursion is asserted: a removed pooled child's own child (a nested component) also ends `mounted: false` / `vnode: null`.
- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/vdom/**` and `test/playwright/unit/grid/Teleportation.spec.mjs` stay green; the full `unit` project at the PR head is green.
- [ ] `syncVnodeTree`'s JSDoc names the extended pass and its guard (placeholder-kept vs removed).
- [ ] Post-merge (institution, owned by #76 there): with the Engine bump, `AddAgentJourneyNL` renders the graduated card and a settled-empty roster refill renders every card.

## Out of Scope

- Any app-side workaround in the fleet roster (`list.Component` pooling stays as is; #76 consumes this leaf).
- The `list.plugin.Animate` fade timing and the store `clear` → list event path.
- Changing when children merge (`canMergeUpdate`) or the collision filter — the unmount pass is the symmetric counterpart of the mount pass and belongs in the sync.

## Avoided Traps

- Replacing pass 1's `getChildren` (nodes in the new tree) with a recursive logical walk — tried 2026-03-08, broke the grid teleportation specs and costs a crawl per sync; the fix touches the UNMOUNT side only.
- Destroying or resetting pooled instances app-side: three shapes tried in the institution (#76 body) — duplicated rows while old ones fade, or lost child components after the re-inline.
- Treating an absent `vnodeMap` entry as removal for a PRUNED branch: the worker keeps pruned subtrees in the returned vnode, so the map distinguishes kept from removed — the existing pass 2 contract; the extension inherits it unchanged.
